structural_rules.missing_parameter: any contract required_input is absent from structured_state.parameters
structural_rules.ambiguous_parameter: a recursive value under structured_state.parameters has status=ambiguous and a non-empty candidates array
structural_rules.version_mismatch: requested_tool_version and contract tool_version are both present and unequal

merge_rule: ordered set union of deterministic structural flags and LLM semantic flags
decision_rule: derive primary_status and action with e2-readiness-policy-v1.0.0 after merge
